season.evidence: Stored Jul-Sep; guide pages call the range best in snow Mar-Jun (ski/snow) with the rock pitch a summer scramble; Mazamas notes early-season snow; ascent histogram peaks May (snow/ski), which is not this route season.

track.why: Logged "East route"; report calls it the standard east route, the 5.0 line that is mostly class 4 with one fifth-class move, to the true summit, which is our standard southeast-face route; track starts and ends within 62-71 m of the Reflection Lakes pin and passes 1 m from summit on 29 Aug 2020.

Aug 2022 climber went up a different gully on the NE side, not the standard line.

31 May 2025 snow climb, more than a month before Jul.
Aug 2026 track tops out 1.2 km from our summit pin.

facts.text: In mid-June the climb is often still a snow outing from the roadside pullout and needs an axe, yet in some years the rock is bare by late June.
Three rappel stations sit on the summit block; their slings looked sound in June 2021 and August 2022, but carry spare webbing anyway.
Where the low trail around the Castle's south ridge looks like sketchy fourth class, drop nearer the end of the ridge before climbing to the crest.
A flat campsite just east of the Castle gives a long Rainier view and suits a tent overnight in late July.
By the third week of June in a normal year the summit blocks can be snow-free while the snow below is still firm early and good for a glissade back to the pullout.

notes: La Villa has no distinguishing evidence in any harvested report. Several tracks are ski or snow ascents (Apr-May) outside the scramble season.
